leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Install and configure TanStack Query in a React TypeScript project using npm or yarn
Implement the QueryClientProvider component to wrap the application and provide query functionality
Define a QueryClient instance with default options for managing server state
Use the useQuery hook to fetch data from an API endpoint in a React component
Apply TypeScript generics to type the data returned by useQuery for type safety
Handle loading states by accessing the isLoading property from useQuery return values
Control error states by accessing the isError and error properties from useQuery return values
Utilize the data property from useQuery to display fetched information in JSX
Construct query keys as arrays to uniquely identify and cache query data
Execute query invalidation using the queryClient.invalidateQueries method to refresh data
Implement the useMutation hook to perform POST, PUT, or DELETE operations
Modify component UI based on mutation status (loading, success, error) using returned properties
